In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a '''pilot''' flew an [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] with the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|retrieved]] the N-1 from the main [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] so [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] could [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|attack]] the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] and disable the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. After the pilot launched, an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] on the N-1 was struck by [[Laser cannon/Legends|cannon]] fire from an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] stationed next to the [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] [[Hangar/Legends|Hangar]]. The starfighter plunged down into the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]] below.<ref name="SWE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot first appeared in [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins.
